The architecture

One policy objective in. Your entire carrier, moving.

Talk to Us

The Lyzr Insurance OS sits at the centre of underwriting, claims and service. It reads every signal across policies, risk and customers, and closes every loop back to your loss-ratio and CX goals.

What does your operation actually need?

The right question changes everything.

Most insurers have deployed AI in pockets. The Lyzr Insurance OS starts with why those pilots haven’t moved the combined ratio and what it takes to run insurance operations on agents that are governed from day one.

Your underwriting teams take 3 days to assess a risk. Your insurtech competitors take 3 minutes.

The Lyzr Insurance OS deploys specialised underwriting agents that gather and synthesise risk data, apply your guidelines and appetite criteria, generate structured risk assessments, recommend pricing, and bind or decline with every decision explainable and auditable.

Which of your claims have fraud signals embedded in them right now?

The Insurance OS monitors claims as they arrive cross-referencing behavioural patterns, historical data, network relationships, and external intelligence feeds. Fraud is flagged before a payment is authorised, not after.

A customer files a claim at 11pm expecting an update before they sleep.

The Insurance OS handles claims intake, acknowledgement, initial assessment, and status communication in real time across every channel, at any hour, without additional headcount. Simple claims resolve automatically.

Only 16% of P&C insurers use AI to augment underwriting, but 60% plan to by 2028.

The Insurance OS is built for insurers who want to be in the 16% today. WTW’s 2026 research found insurers using sophisticated analytics achieved combined ratios six points lower and premium growth three points higher.

From objective to outcome

This is how insurance operations transform.

Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco, Sapiens, your claims management platform, your policy administration system, your fraud detection tools connect what you have. Nothing migrates. Your data stays in your sovereign cloud environment.

Zero rip-and-replace — the intelligence layer that makes every system you already run work together toward your loss ratio and growth objectives.

Not a process improvement. A goal. “Reduce combined ratio by 4 points.” “Achieve straight-through processing on 60% of personal lines claims.” The OS reads your live data and returns a ranked execution plan with reasoning attached.

Objective-first. Compliant by design. Regulators get the audit trail they require.

From 400+ agents, the OS calls what’s relevant: underwriting risk assessment, claims triage, fraud detection, compliance monitoring, customer communication, reinsurance reporting. Autonomy is staged within your risk appetite.

Staged autonomy · Earned, not assumed. Agents pause for authorisation before any coverage denial, fraud flag, or settlement offer.

Claims get settled. Risks get underwritten. Fraud gets caught. The OS tracks every outcome against your business objective and every decision is explainable, at the moment it was made, to whoever asks.

Explainable at execution · Auditable always.

The question you’re already asking

Your data. Your agents. Your call. Always.

Sovereign, governed and model-agnostic by design, so every agent and every workflow stays yours.

  • Stays in your environment

    Lyzr deploys in your cloud: AWS, Azure, GCP, or on-premise. No data leaves. No training on your proprietary information. 80% of enterprise deployments choose private cloud.

  • Governed at every step

    Every agent action is logged. Every output validated. Human-in-the-loop controls for every decision that matters. SOC 2 Type II. GDPR-ready. EU AI Act compliant path.

  • No lock-in. Ever.

    What you build on Lyzr belongs to you. Walk away with every agent, every workflow, every intelligence layer fully intact. We are the infrastructure, not the owner of what you create on it.

  • Any model. Any framework.

    OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, open-source. LangChain, CrewAI, Agentforce. Lyzr runs them all under one control plane. You’re never dependent on one provider’s roadmap.
